parameters.query:
with p as (select $1::jsonb as j)
insert into public.chat_turns (
  trace_id, user_id, question, answer,
  top_score, fallback_type, prompt_version, model, latency_ms,
  sources_json, created_at
)
select
  j->>'trace_id',
  j->>'user_id',
  coalesce(j->>'question','[missing]'),
  coalesce(j->>'answer',''),
  nullif(j->>'top_score','')::double precision,
  nullif(j->>'fallback_type','')::text,
  nullif(j->>'prompt_version','')::text,
  nullif(j->>'model','')::text,
  nullif(j->>'latency_ms','')::int,
  j->'sources_json',
  now()
from p;
